COUNTER_BITS = 16
COUNTER_MODULUS = 1 << COUNTER_BITS  # 65536 ticks -> wraps every 6.5536 s
TICKS_PER_SECOND = 10_000


def gate_time_s(start_tick, stop_tick):
    """Return the sprint time in seconds from two latched 16-bit counter values.

    The counter runs at 10,000 ticks per second and rolls over every
    65,536 ticks (6.5536 s). Because sprints take under 6 seconds, at most
    one rollover can occur between the start and stop latches, so the
    elapsed tick count is recovered with modular subtraction.
    """
    elapsed_ticks = (stop_tick - start_tick) % COUNTER_MODULUS
    return elapsed_ticks / TICKS_PER_SECOND
